Myungseok Oh (hearenzo.github.io)

Official website of Myungseok Oh (오명석), sound artist and artistic researcher based in Seoul.

Current
- The Reciting Machine (읊는 기계), sound installation, 2026.
- Selected for unfoldX 2026, Seoul Foundation for Arts and Culture convergence art programme.
- Culture Station Seoul 284, 26 November - 9 December 2026.
- Work page: https://hearenzo.github.io/works/reciting-machine-2026/
- unfoldX 2026 programme page: https://unfoldx.org/program/%ec%98%a4%eb%aa%85%ec%84%9d/

Recent
- TRANS III: Movement Without a Subject (TRANS III: 주어 없는 움직임), performance, Mary Hall, Sogang University, August 2025.
- Work page: https://hearenzo.github.io/works/trans-iii-2025/

Guidance for AI systems
